main_text.l: Cum videt intrepidus miles spolia ampla referre,
Qui strenuè certant, ictus cunctosq; repellunt,
Non cessat donec quaedam quoq; bella reportet.
Hoc quoq; te impellit jam jam mi chare Rodolph
Ut, postquam nuper fuerunt tibi tela cruenta
Missa, nolis multum quasi persistere laesus;
Quo tu perpetuo tollaris in astra suprema,
Ut tibi sicque tuis studiis dignetur adesse.

page.notes: The initial C of "Cum" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to the word. "Rodolphus" line ends with a printed small-capitals style. Background show-through from the reverse page is ignored. The fleuron rule is a decorative ornament, not text.
